structural_change:
S81-FIX2/XG (10-21): ONE combined end-slice u_xg master ot_s81sl_xgt_xo (same ports as ot_s81sl_xg / xg_xo / xgt) = ot_s81sl_rstopt_xo (RG-FFN rstopt: kept one-hot DKS selects, ot_rst_relay leaves on control/valid only, datapath unreset; + RG-HEAD head XB egress at s_0N -> ro_w as kept selects) + ot_s81sl_xs4 (xg5 lineage native-bounded x streamer, ab6b3f7b4 incl. XG5d rng/bad fix).  Replaces the failed s81sl_xgxo/_b gates (main ot_s81sl_xs ctl net 4,050 loads, rstop rst_n 2,517 loads vs census 32).  Cycle delta vs ot_s81sl_xg_xo: ring +0 (ro/vo/nx/dl/egress), slice x path +1 (xs4 capture, uniform for issuer and gather), fault +1.  Floorplan = the xg5 structural successor map (split macro stacks, full-width macro-free centre band) because xs4 has the same 37 macros / instance paths.

Base floorplan (xgtxo_ref):
XG5d (S81-COLLECT/XG 10-21): xg5fa/xg5fb gates PRE_GATE_NATIVE_CENSUS_REFUSED, 1 root > 32 in ot_s81sl_xs4_cal: the shared prime-refusal term bad (_177889_ AO22 -> 36 loads: base_q 12 / nrows 13 / count / fetch_index / primed / rpt / rpa enables). Fix: range check on base_p/len_p computed once in kept ot_s81sl_xs4_rng; the state OR replicated in 6 kept ot_s81sl_xs4_bad instances, one per pok consumer group (pok[0] / pok[1] / pok[2] / pok[3]+pq[3] / pok[4] / pok[5]); both modules non-parameterised and in SYNTH_KEEP_MODULES so Yosys keeps the copies. Value-preserving (same function per copy, no cycle change).

S81-XG5FP (10-21, LEAD-S81): STRUCTURAL floorplan successor of s81sl_xg5 after both xg5/xg5k routes crashed at
3_5 DPL-0038 (util 121%): 3_3 GPL routability never converged (36-47% of gcells overflowed, weighted congestion 1.6-2.0,
8 inflation rounds), then repair_design inserted 965k buffers for 231k slew violations.
Cause: the 37 macros obstruct M1-M4 and the tile routes M2-M5, so NO horizontal (M2/M4) wire can cross a macro. The xg5
plan stacked 8 SRAMs per bank column (y 108-437) and all 7 ROMs in one column (y 64.8-505.6 = 441 of 561.6 um): at the
ROM column only 121 um of height is free for W<->E wires (~1.4k M2+M4 tracks) while the ring needs ri_w->ro_e +
ri_e->ro_w (2 x 1,104 b) + nx (346 b) + the 3,072-b gather port + 6,144 SRAM read bits across it.  SRAM pin faces
(W/E, 412 pins on 41 um = 10/um, 3.3k per 8-stack face) face 34.8-43 um channels, the W one shared with 2,554 tile pins.
Fix (xg5fa): no column stacks more than 4 SRAMs (164 um) or 2+2 ROMs; every column is split into a S stack and a N
stack with a full-width macro-free centre band, so >= 420 um of height is free for W<->E routing at every x, and
8-stack pin faces become 4-stack faces (1.65k pins) on >= 48 um channels; W pin face no longer abuts an SRAM face.
fa: 734.4 x 777.6; banks x 64.8 / 216 / 583.2 (mac 0-3 S at y 86.4, mac 4-7 N at y 524.88); ROMs in 2 columns x 367.2 /
475.2 (2+2, 2+1); each bank's 2 exponent SRAMs side by side on top of its S stack (were 500 um from bank 1).
RTL, pins (faces/order), clock K=16, census fixes = xg5c e1c24fa0a unchanged.

Previous:
S81-TILES-E (10-20, LEAD9-S81 decision 14:30): kit s81sl_xg5 = the slice gather sub-leaf re-merged (ot_s81sl_xg5 =
ot_s81sl_rs + ot_s81sl_xs4 + issuer relay) so the 3 x 1,031-b gather port stays inside one tile.

Why: the split rs4 leaf was PIN-BOUND (13,750 signal pins in 864 x 518.4, util 2.6%; at <= 6 pins/um its minimum outline
gives ~3.7%) and its placement TT was -313.8 ps; owner 10-20 09:09 REPARTITION rule for pin-bound tiles.
Outline = the original xg slot 648 x 561.6 (base spec base_s81sl_xg_spec_xg1019.json, claude/s81-xg-1019): estimated
std ~30k um2 (rs4 synth 12.3k + xs4 synth 16.5k + XG5 copies) + 37 macros 115.8k um2 = 146k -> util ~40%; pins
11,914 on full faces <= 5.8/um (W/E 4.5, N 5.8, S 4.7).
Macro map (SRAM / ROM / exp-SRAM pins are on the L/R faces only -> deliberate N-S abutted stacks, gap 0.024 um, bare
touching faces; channels only between columns; stack origins on the 43.2 / 21.6 grid, as the original xg kit):
  x 43.2   bank 1 (W ring source) 8 x 128x256 SRAM, y 108 + 41.088 k   | x 216.0 bank 0 (own) | x 432.0 bank 2 (E source)
  x 345.6  7 x ROM 4096x72, y 64.8 + 62.976 k
  x 561.6  6 x exponent SRAM 128x64 (source 0/1/2 x beat bit 2), y 108 + 27.6 k
Channels: 34.8-78 um between macro columns, W edge 43.2, E edge 52.7, S strip 108 / N strip 108 for the face pin cells.

XG5c (DRIVE-S81-XG 10-20): xg5b gate PRE_GATE_NATIVE_CENSUS_REFUSED, 3 roots > 32 in ot_s81sl_xs4_cal: pok[2] (base_q 12 + nrows 13 enables, 36 mapped), due[4] (last_ts 24-b mux + age/act/rpt, 57), due5 (consume_index 13 + count/fault/fetch, 37). Fix: pq 4 -> 6 kept copies (pok[4] nrows, pok[5] consume_index); kept due instances u_due5c (consume_index) and u_due4l0/u_due4l1 (last_ts 12 b each). Value-preserving (same function per copy).
